note: Level 2 hooks are all stage 'scenario': the golden-path walk stays the level 1 walk, and every level 2 surface is driven and verified by the grader. Repeated-testid rules follow level 1 conventions (one entry per row, containing the identifying text).

hooks.element: control at room creation that marks the room private
hooks.note: present on the room creation surface; its state at creation decides visibility

hooks.element: marker on a room that is private, visible to its members
input where a room owner enters a username to invite
error shown when an action is refused for lack of permission
hooks.note: visible after a refused action; must not appear on permitted ones

hooks.element: panel showing a user's profile, opened by clicking their username
hooks.note: one panel; contents change with the user being viewed

hooks.element: the viewed user's display name inside the profile panel
the viewed user's bio inside the profile panel
hooks.note: live while the panel is open — an edit by the profile's owner appears without reopening

hooks.element: control that closes the profile panel
input where a user edits their own bio
hooks.note: only on the viewer's own profile

hooks.element: control that saves the bio edit
hooks.note: only on the viewer's own profile

hooks.element: control on another user's profile that sends a friend request
hooks.note: absent on one's own profile and on an existing friend's profile

hooks.element: one entry per incoming friend request (repeated testid), containing the sender's username
control on a pending request that accepts it
control on a pending request that declines it
one entry per friend in the friends list (repeated testid), containing that friend's username
online/offline indicator inside a friend entry
hooks.note: contains the word 'online' or 'offline'; flips live when the friend signs in or out

hooks.element: control inside a friend entry that removes the friendship
